verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Purify my heart
Let me be as gold,
And precious silver

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Purify my heart
Let me be as gold, pure gold

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Refiner's Fire, my heart's one desire
Is to be holy, set apart for You, Lord

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I choose to be holy
Set apart for You, my Master
Ready to do Your will

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Purify my heart
Cleanse me from within,
And make me holy

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Purify my heart
Cleanse me from my sin, deep within
